tests.name: Real password authentication for three QA accounts
Private settings inaccessible to another account
Protected PDF upload and server-side validation
Private PDF and metadata cannot be accessed by outsiders
Authorized PDF download returns PDF bytes
Bookmarks, notes and normalized highlights persist privately
Reading progress refuses stale device overwrites
Reading metrics aggregate actual events and reject repeated bursts
Direct conversation is atomic and private
Message history survives a fresh client session
Third party cannot read or forge private messages
Public club join and real club chat work
Social post, reaction and comment persist
Account export returns only requester personal rows
